# Authentication

Requests to the REST API require the following tokens in the header:

- **`X-User-Company`**
  - The unique name of your company.
- **`X-User-Email`**
  - This is the userid (typically the email which is used for login) for your account.
- **`X-User-Token`**
  - You can find the token associated with your user in the User settings page in your account at [https://app.ordwaylabs.com/setup/users](https://app.ordwaylabs.com/setup/users).
  - This can also be re-generated from this page.
- **`X-API-KEY`**
  - Please contact the customer success team for the unique key that is generated for your company.
- **`Content-Type`**
  - application/json
  - This is optional but best practice to send it.
